mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative over the 20-day horizon despite a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS, or FEDFUNDS begins rising before the horizon ends.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative over the 5-day horizon despite UNRATE crossing below 3.5%, or UNRATE rises back above 3.5% within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indices indicate stronger supply-side activity, stimulating demand and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon despite sustained growth in INDPRO, or INDPRO declines before the horizon ends.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in the Federal Funds Rate and CPIAUCSL index signal aggressive monetary easing, reducing real interest rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS or CPIAUCSL fails to meet the threshold, or S&P 500 returns are negative despite both proxies declining.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, a sustained decline in the Federal Funds Rate below 2.5% predicts lower discount rates on equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime shifts to a tightening cycle before the horizon, or S&P 500 returns are negative despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing corporate profit margins and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE fails to cross above 3.5% within the horizon, or S&P 500 returns are positive despite the unemployment rate rising above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and personal consumption (GDPC1) indicates robust demand and supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either INDPRO or GDPC1 fails to meet the threshold, or S&P 500 returns are negative despite both proxies rising.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trajectory in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) reflects stronger domestic demand, stimulating corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 stops rising or declines before the horizon, or S&P 500 returns are negative despite GDPC1 increasing.
